# Unsettled

> Unsettled: Impossible Escape is a spy puzzle game for iPhone, hidden in an ordinary-looking phone. Each message is a lock, and every lock gives up a number.

Available now on the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18 or later
- Price: chapters one and two are free; chapter three is a one-off £2.99 unlock; three extra hints cost £0.99
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking; nothing leaves the phone
- Content: three chapters and thirty-five locks
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [Unsettled website](https://unsettled.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/unsettled-impossible-escape/id6819058615): download the app
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/unsettled): background from the developer

## Features

- Escape room puzzles hidden in an ordinary-looking phone
- Ciphers, codes and riddles whose answers are numbers
- Three chapters and thirty-five locks
- A sealed message at the end of each chapter
- Hints earned every five levels

## FAQ

### Is Unsettled really impossible?

No, but it is hard. Every level is tested to have exactly one answer, and everything you need is already in front of you.

### Is there a walkthrough?

No. That's the point. Earn a hint every five levels, or buy a hint pack if you're truly stuck.

### Is it suitable for escape room fans?

Yes. Unsettled is a digital escape room where the room is a phone: ciphers, hidden clues and misdirection, with a spy story told through sealed messages.

### How much does it cost?

Chapters one and two are free. Chapter three is a one-off £2.99 unlock, and three extra hints cost £0.99. There are no ads.

### Which devices are supported?

iPhone running iOS 18 or later.
